messages:
deploybot: PREFLIGHT EVAL BLOCKED › release=rls-2.9.0 model=redwood/summarizer-v3 prompt-suite=regression_prompt_set 3/120 tests > threshold (avg delta +12%) — rollout blocked :warning:
Mia Chen: ugh. which tests? any high-severity user-facing diffs? :eyes:
deploybot: failing_tests: ["summarize_email_long_threads", "meeting_notes_abbrev", "product_summary_consistency"]; top delta on summarize_email_long_threads — hallucination-style substitutions increased in 2 samples.
Jordan Patel: tagging @Sanjay for model-quality context. Sanjay — are these expected from the quant artifacts we landed in the last build?
Sanjay Rao: not expected at that magnitude. quick hypothesis: kernel selection fallback on longer contexts caused attention smoothing. need to bisect between build-9482 and build-9476.
Elaine Park: QA can re-run the prompt-suite with expanded sampling and the new eval harness, but it takes ~20m. I can start now if y'all want a fresh run after the hotfix branch is built.
Kevin Ortiz: priority reminder: we have a change window tomorrow 02:00 UTC for this region. If we can't get a clear pass by then we should either pin or rollback to avoid violating the SLA.
Mia Chen: agree. two options: (A) pin traffic to current canary (model v3.0-rc1 -> keep) while we ship a hotfix, or (B) full rollback to v2.8.7 and abort today's release. Preference for pin+hotfix if fix is small.
Jordan Patel: can we pin just the summarizer route and continue other routes? deploybot, can you split routing config per route?
deploybot: yes — canary routing supports per-route pinning. Command: ```deploybot pin-route --route=summarizer --version=2.8.7 --until="2026-03-21T06:00:00Z"``` returns: pending approval by infra-sig.
Mia Chen: ok let's do per-route pin for now. Elaine, please kick off expanded eval on the pinned route and attach sample diffs. Sanjay/Jordan to triage bisect. Kevin, please hold the change window update until we confirm pass/fail.
Elaine Park: starting eval run now: `./tools/eval_runner --suite=regression_prompt_set --samples=500 --out=artifacts/2765432109/` — will post results here in ~25m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Sanjay Rao: starting bisect: building candidate hotfix branch with kernel flag `--attention-norm=stable-v2` and quant config rollback to q8_zp for last layer. quick build ETA 18m.
Jordan Patel: I'll draft a short message for release-notes: "Release held for summarizer quality gate — investigations in progress; publication paused." Mia — want to add anything?
Mia Chen: keep it short. also add that customers on Dedicated will be unaffected due to routing pin.
Kevin Ortiz: opsbot — please create an incident-style ticket for tracking and link to this thread. opsbot: incident ID INC-2026-874 created: https://internal/insights/INC-2026-874 — assigned to @Kevin Ortiz and @Jordan Patel.
deploybot: approval needed: infra-sig required. Jordan/Mia, please sign off on `pin-route` command in the infra-sig channel or reply with :thumbsup: here.
Jordan Patel: :thumbsup: I approve the pin-route for summarizer.
Mia Chen: :thumbsup:
deploybot: executing pin-route now... done — traffic shifted. current summarizer traffic -> v2.8.7 (100% for production), canary still running v3 on staging.
Elaine Park: eval run complete — results uploaded: artifacts/2765432109/eval_report.html — summary: 3 regressions re-evaluated; two are noise-level after sampling; `summarize_email_long_threads` still shows notable delta (precision drop). attaching sample diffs.
Sanjay Rao: bisect narrowed to change in attention kernel selector (commit c9b2a7). I'll revert that selection in a hotfix branch and trigger a build. If hotfix addresses it, we can re-promote.
Mia Chen: timeline: hotfix build + eval by 02:00 UTC? If yes we can keep the window. If not, leave pin in place until hotfix validated.
Sanjay Rao: pushing hotfix now — will update in ~25m.
Kevin Ortiz: updating change window calendar: pinned in prod for summarizer until 06:00 UTC 2026-03-21. Release notes publish paused.
Jordan Patel: once hotfix passes, plan: 1) promote hotfix to canary, 2) run quick smoke, 3) remove pin, 4) publish release notes. Keep this thread for sign-off.
Mia Chen: thanks all. small ask — Jordan, include the short blurb about pin in the release changelog draft so marketing doesn't accidentally publish.
Jordan Patel: will do.
deploybot: thread closed by action: route-pinned; follow-ups scheduled. :white_check_mark:
